blurb: Guests can experience helicopter tours over Durango and surrounding landscapes, flight training to become skilled pilots, and helicopter charters to various local destinations. The company also offers turbine transition training with high altitude mountain training and external load work. They operate as a Part 135 and 133 operator and provide specialized mountain, turbine, SAR, and airborne law enforcement training.
